name: qubit-office3
label: Voice Chat
description: Voice Chat — talk to Qubit and let it talk back. Push-to-talk speech in, the transcript sent through the same text path typing uses, each agent answered with a stable voice derived from its name. Browser-native (Web Speech API); hides the mic when SpeechRecognition is absent and the mute toggle when speechSynthesis is absent, and reports the bridge's real error rather than a fabricated success.
